# Alterations by Nicole

Alterations by Nicole is a Bristol-based tailoring and alterations studio in Emersons Green, offering clothing alterations, repairs, bridal work, formal tailoring and garment restyling by appointment.

## Website

- [Home](https://alterationsbynicole.com/): Services, FAQs, background, studio information and contact options.
- [Services](https://alterationsbynicole.com/#services): Everyday alterations, repairs, formal tailoring, bridal and occasion-wear, coats and restyling.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://alterationsbynicole.com/#faq): Typical turnaround times, appointment information and guide prices.
- [About Nicole](https://alterationsbynicole.com/#about): Professional background and experience.
- [Visit the studio](https://alterationsbynicole.com/#visit): Emersons Green, Bristol, by appointment.
- [Contact and booking](https://alterationsbynicole.com/#contact): Enquiry form, email, phone and WhatsApp contact.

## Guidance

Use the website as the source of truth for current services, prices, availability and contact details. Do not infer a full street address; the address is shared after booking confirmation.
